judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a classic rubber ducky shape with a distinct body and head, colored bright yellow.
The duck must have an orange beak and a simple black dot for an eye.
Draw a white, claw-foot bathtub shape, showing the inside view with a visible rim.
requirements.note: The tub is a white rounded-rectangle basin sitting flat on the floor with only a drop shadow; no feet of any kind are drawn.

requirements.text: Fill the lower portion of the bathtub with light blue water.
Ensure the water line is clearly visible across the duck's body, showing the lower third of the duck submerged.
Position the duck so it is floating on the water's surface, creating small, concentric circular ripples in the water around its base.
requirements.note: The ripple marks are three long horizontal wavy strokes running the full width of the tub plus a dark shadow ellipse; none of them is a concentric circle around the duck's base.

requirements.text: Depict soap bubbles as clusters of overlapping circles with a slight iridescence, using semi-transparent white, light pink, and light blue fills.
requirements.note: Every bubble is a plain white circle with a white glow; the render contains no pink pixels at all, so the light pink fill is missing.

requirements.text: Place a small cluster of bubbles on top of the duck's head.
requirements.note: The duck's head carries no bubbles.

requirements.text: Place a large pile of bubbles against one side of the tub and a few floating on the water's surface around the duck.
requirements.note: Four small clusters of roughly six circles sit symmetrically at the two ends of the tub; none is a large pile banked against one side, and the clusters sit at the tub ends rather than floating around the duck.
